# EzPace

> EzPace is a demo running-coaching site by Dawid Olko: training plans counted back from a race date, a pace calculator with splits, and heart-rate zones. It is a static site in English and Polish.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://ezpace.dawidolko.pl/): plans, pace calculator, how the coaching works, results and FAQ
- [Home (Polish)](https://ezpace.dawidolko.pl/pl/): the same page in Polish

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer who built this site
